entities.name: Ibrahim Pasha Mosque
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Ibrahim Pasha Mosque, also known as the Maqbul Ibrahim Pasha Mosque, is one of the largest mosques on the Balkan Peninsula outside of Turkish East Thrace, and the second-largest in Bulgaria. Located in the town of Razgrad, the mosque is one of the most exquisite examples of Ottoman classical architecture.
